POST/v1/record/filter/app/{app_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/filter/app/1 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "filters": [ { "field_id": "1", "field_type": "single_text", "match_type": "contains", "values": [ { "value": "John" } ], "type": "text" } ] }' Response { "total": 3, "cursor": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJibGFiRGVmSWQiOjgsInZhbHVlcyI6WzE1OV0sImV4cCI6MTY1MDYxODc3OH0.iY5TnLSBDGCnFXbStcrLPTmP6MATnS_JKywbvC4tx3g", "records": [ { "record_id": 3, "title": "John Doe", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:48:42", "app": { "app_id": 1, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "John Doe" } ] } ] }, { "record_id": 2, "title": "Alison Johnsson", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:43:03", "app": { "app_id": 1, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Alison Johnsson" } ] } ] }, { "record_id": 1, "title": "Karl John III", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:43:03", "app": { "app_id": 1, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Karl John III" } ] } ] } ] } All filters must match (AND). Put the field ID in field_id, because the slug doesn't work in filters. For every other field type, see Filter. To get the next page, send the returned cursor in the query string of your next request. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters limitinteger Number of records to return (default: 50). Min 1 Max 500 cursorstring Cursor of the next page. sort_bystring The field ID or the field's slug (returned as external_id in records) to sort by. sort_descboolean Sort in descending order (default: false). Body parameters filtersArray Filters to apply. A record is returned only if it matches all of them. Retrieve records for a view​ Use this endpoint to list the records of a view, page by page. GET/v1/record/view/{view_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/view/1?limit=2 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "total": 2, "cursor": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJibGFiRGVmSWQiOjgsInZhbHVlcyI6WzE1OV0sImV4cCI6MTY1MDYxODc3OH0.iY5TnLSBDGCnFXbStcrLPTmP6MATnS_JKywbvC4tx3g", "records": [ { "record_id": 2, "title": "Clara Weber", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:48:42", "app": { "app_id": 1, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Clara Weber" } ] } ] }, { "record_id": 1, "title": "Andrea Lim", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:43:03", "app": { "app_id": 1, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Andrea Lim" } ] } ] } ] } To find a view_id, see Retrieve views for an app, which lists the public views of an app. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters limitinteger Number of records to return (default: 50). Min 1 Max 500 cursorstring Cursor of the next page. Retrieve shared records​ Use this endpoint to list the records that were shared with you individually, newest first. GET/v1/record/sharedNewapi.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/shared?limit=20 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "records": [ { "record_id": 170471696, "app_record_id": 42, "record_url": "https://tapeapp.com/acme/record/170471696", "app_id": 4821, "app": { "app_id": 4821, "name": "Customer Onboarding", "record_name": "Onboarding", "workspace_id": 913, "workspace": { "workspace_id": 913, "name": "Sales", "external_id": "sales", "org_id": 77 }, "icon": "event_available" }, "title": "Acme Corp onboarding", "created_on": "2026-08-03 09:14:22", "created_on_utc": "2026-08-03 07:14:22", "created_by": { "type": "user", "id": 5501, "user_id": 5501, "org_id": 77, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "email": "juliet@acme.com", "name": "Juliet Adams" }, "current_revision": null, "initial_revision": null } ], "cursor": null } The response is shortened. app also holds a config copy of its properties, and current_revision and initial_revision hold the record's latest and first revision. Each record is a preview with the same properties as a record result of the search. General behavior The list holds records shared with you through the record itself, in database apps you can't open otherwise. A shared record in a database you can open isn't listed. Read it with Retrieve records for an app. Records come back as previews without field values. Read one in full with Retrieve a record. To get the next page, send the returned cursor. Repeat until cursor is null. A full page doesn't mean that more pages exist. The response has no total. A personal access token with limited content access returns only the records in the databases its content access includes. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key. Errors An automation API key returns 400 with validation, because it acts for no user. Query parameters limitinteger Number of records to return (default: 50). Min 1 Max 100 cursorstring Cursor of the next page. Retrieve statistics of related records​ Use this endpoint to count or sum up a field over all records related to one record. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/reference/{field_id}/statsapi.tapeapp.com Request curl "https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/1/reference/12/stats?aggregation_type=SUM" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "result": 3, "source_record_id": 1, "target_field_id": 12 } The example sums up the number field 12 over all records related to record 1. General behavior The endpoint looks at every record of the field's app that is related to record_id, through incoming or outgoing relations. It aggregates the field field_id over these records. Requirements: records:read, and view access to the record and to the field's app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters aggregation_typestring One of COUNT (default), COUNT_NOT_EMPTY, COUNT_EMPTY, PERCENT_EMPTY, PERCENT_NOT_EMPTY, SUM, AVG, MEDIAN, MIN or MAX. SUM, AVG, MEDIAN, MIN and MAX work only on number fields and on calculation fields that return a number. Retrieve related records for a set of records​ Use this endpoint to get the records of another database app that are related to a set of records. POST/v1/record/app/{app_id}/ref/{ref_app_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/app/1/ref/2?limit=10 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "recordIds": [100, 101], "direction": "forward" }' Response { "total": 2, "records": [ { "record_id": 2, "title": "Clara Weber", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:48:42", "app": { "app_id": 2, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Clara Weber" } ] } ] }, { "record_id": 1, "title": "Andrea Lim", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:43:03", "app": { "app_id": 2, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Andrea Lim" } ] } ] } ] } The example returns the records of app 2 that are related to the records 100 and 101 of app 1. General behavior The endpoint returns at most 1000 records. It has no pagination. total is the number of records in this response, not the number of all related records. An unknown direction returns no records instead of an error. Use forward, reverse or both. limit applies before access checks. Records you can't view are removed afterwards, so total can be lower than limit. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters limitinteger Number of records to return (default: 1000). Min 1 Max 1000 Body parameters directionstring Direction of the relations. forward: relation fields of the source records point to the target records. reverse: relation fields of the target records point to the source records. both: either way. recordIdsinteger[] IDs of the source records. All must belong to the app app_id. relationFieldIdsinteger[] IDs of the relation fields to follow. Optional. Find relatable records for a relation field​ Use this endpoint to search for records you can add to a relation field. GET/v1/record/field/{field_id}/findapi.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/field/1/find?text=adam \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "total": 1, "records": [ { "record_id": 2, "title": "Clara Weber", "created_on": "2022-03-23 08:48:42", "app": { "app_id": 1, "icon": "event_available", "name": "Contacts", "record_name": "Contact", "workspace_id": 1 } } ] } In the example, field 1 is a relation field to the app Contacts. The endpoint returns at most 10 records. It has no pagination and accepts no cursor or limit. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key. Query parameters textstring The text to search for. Batch create multiple records​ Use this endpoint to create up to 50 records in one request. POST/v1/record/app/batch/{app_id}Newapi.tapeapp.com cURL JSON Request curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/app/batch/1 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "inputs": [ { "fields": { "full_name": "Clara Weber" } }, { "fields": { "full_name": "Pete Miller" } } ] }' Request { "inputs": [ { "fields": { "full_name": "Clara Weber" } }, { "fields": { "full_name": "Pete Miller" } } ] } Response { "records": [ { "record_id": 1, "title": "Clara Weber", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Clara Weber" } ] } ] }, { "record_id": 2, "title": "Pete Miller", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Pete Miller" } ] } ] } ] } Send one object per record in the inputs array. Each object has a fields object, as in Create a record. General behavior One request creates at most 50 records. A longer inputs array returns an error. If one input fails, no record is created. The response has status 201. Requirements: records:edit. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters silentboolean Don't send notifications for this change (default: false). hookboolean Run webhooks for this change (default: true). workflowboolean Trigger automations for this change (default: true). reject_unreferencable_relation_targetsboolean Reject the request with 400 if a relation value points to a record that can't be referenced. Otherwise, that reference is dropped (default: false). reject_unresolvable_option_valuesboolean Reject the request with 400 if a category or status value matches no option. Otherwise, a category value is skipped. A status value without a match returns 400 in any case, because a status field can't be empty (default: false). apply_user_timezone_on_date_inputsboolean Read date values without a UTC offset in your timezone instead of UTC (default: false). Batch update multiple records​ Use this endpoint to update up to 50 records of a database app in one request. PUT/v1/record/app/batch/{app_id}Newapi.tapeapp.com cURL JSON Request curl -X PUT https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/app/batch/1 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "inputs": [ { "record_id": 1, "fields": { "full_name": "Clara Weber" } }, { "record_id": 2, "fields": { "full_name": "Pete Miller" } } ] }' Request { "inputs": [ { "record_id": 1, "fields": { "full_name": "Clara Weber" } }, { "record_id": 2, "fields": { "full_name": "Pete Miller" } } ] } Response { "records": [ { "record_id": 1, "title": "Clara Weber", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Clara Weber" } ] } ] }, { "record_id": 2, "title": "Pete Miller", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "fields": [ { "field_id": 1, "external_id": "full_name", "label": "Full Name", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [ { "value": "Pete Miller" } ] } ] } ] } Send one object per record in the inputs array. Each object has a record_id and a fields object, as in Update a record. General behavior One request updates at most 50 records. A longer inputs array returns an error. If one input fails, no record is updated. Don't need the updated records? Set empty_response to true for a faster response. Requirements: records:edit. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters silentboolean Don't send notifications for this change (default: false). hookboolean Run webhooks for this change (default: true). workflowboolean Trigger automations for this change (default: true). empty_responseboolean Don't return the updated records (default: false). reject_unreferencable_relation_targetsboolean Reject the request with 400 if a relation value points to a record that can't be referenced. Otherwise, that reference is dropped (default: false). reject_unresolvable_option_valuesboolean Reject the request with 400 if a category or status value matches no option. Otherwise, a category field is cleared. A status value without a match returns 400 in any case, because a status field can't be empty (default: false). apply_user_timezone_on_date_inputsboolean Read date values without a UTC offset in your timezone instead of UTC (default: false).

Field value the value format of every field type. App read the field IDs and slugs of an app. Filter all filters for filtered records. Pagination read long lists page by page. File upload a file to attach it to a record. Webhook get notified when records change. Record comment comment on a record. Capabilities what records:read and records:edit allow.

Every comment endpoint returns comments in this format. The example comment has one attached file: Comment { "comment_id": 1000, "value": "The contract is attached.", "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "files": [ { "file_id": "comment-file-5001", "name": "contract.pdf", "mimetype": "application/pdf", "size": 48213, "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "created_on_utc": "2022-03-01 11:00:00" } ], "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "created_on_utc": "2022-03-01 11:00:00", "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "type": "user", "org_id": 1, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams" }, "user": { "user_id": 600, "type": "user", "org_id": 1, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams" } } The example comes from a user whose timezone is one hour ahead of UTC. comment_idnumber The comment ID. Example value 1000 valuestring Text of the comment, as plain text. Line breaks are \n. Mentions use the same syntax as in Create a record comment. Example value "The contract is attached." refobject What the comment belongs to. type is record, id is the record ID. Example value { "type": "record", "id": 1 } filesarray Files attached to the comment. Empty when there are none. See Comment files. Example value [] created_onstring When the comment was written, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in your timezone. See Date & timezone. Example value "2022-03-01 12:00:00" created_on_utcstring The same moment as created_on, in UTC. Example value "2022-03-01 11:00:00" created_byobject | null The user who wrote the comment, or null if no user is the author. Example value { "user_id": 600, "type": "user", … } userobject | null Same as created_by. Example value { "user_id": 600, "type": "user", … } The author object has user_id, type ("user"), org_id, mail (a list with the email address of the user) and name.

file_idstring ID of the file, with the prefix comment-file-. Use it in attachment_ids of the Email resource. Example value "comment-file-5001" namestring File name. Example value "contract.pdf" mimetypestring MIME type of the file. Example value "application/pdf" sizenumber File size in bytes. Example value 48213 created_onstring When the file was uploaded, in your timezone. Example value "2022-03-01 12:00:00" created_on_utcstring The same moment as created_on, in UTC. Example value "2022-03-01 11:00:00" Create a record comment​ Use this endpoint to add a comment to a record. POST/v1/comment/record/{record_id}api.tapeapp.com cURL JSON Request curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/comment/record/1 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "value": "This is a comment on record with ID 1." }' Request { "value": "This is a comment on record with ID 1." } Response { "comment_id": 1000, "value": "This is a comment on record with ID 1.", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "files": [], "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" }, "user": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" } } Send the text of the comment in value. The example adds a plain text comment to the record with ID 1. General behavior value supports plain text with a few formatting options: Force a line break with \n. Mention a user with the ID and name of the user, for example @[Juliet Adams](user:123) for the user with ID 123. To find a user ID, see Retrieve organization users. To attach files, send their temporary file IDs in file_ids, like for the attachment field type. See File. Requirements: records.comments:edit. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters silentboolean Don't send notifications for this change (default: false). hookboolean Run webhooks for this change (default: true). workflowboolean Trigger automations for this change (default: true). Body parameters valuestring Required. Text of the comment. file_idsArray Temporary file IDs of the files to attach. Retrieve a comment​ Use this endpoint to read one comment by its ID. GET/v1/comment/{comment_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/comment/1000 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "comment_id": 1000, "value": "This is a comment on record with ID 1.", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "files": [], "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" }, "user": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" } } ref points to the record the comment belongs to. Requirements: records.comments:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key. Delete a comment​ Use this endpoint to delete a comment by its ID. DELETE/v1/comment/{comment_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl -X DELETE https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/comment/1000 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response {} General behavior You can delete only your own comments. To delete a reply, use Delete a comment or reply. Requirements: records.comments:edit. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key. Query parameters silentboolean Don't send notifications for this change (default: false). hookboolean Run webhooks for this change (default: true). Retrieve comments for a record​ Use this endpoint to list the comments on a record, page by page. GET/v1/comment/record/{record_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/comment/record/1?limit=2 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "total": 2, "cursor": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJibGFiRGVmSWQiOjgsInZhbHVlcyI6WzE1OV0sImV4cCI6MTY1MDYxODc3OH0.iY5TnLSBDGCnFXbStcrLPTmP6MATnS_JKywbvC4tx3g", "comments": [ { "comment_id": 1000, "value": "This is a comment on record with ID 1.", "created_on": "2022-03-01 12:00:00", "files": [], "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" }, "user": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" } }, { "comment_id": 1001, "value": "This is another comment on record with ID 1.", "created_on": "2022-03-01 13:00:00", "files": [], "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" }, "user": { "user_id": 600, "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "name": "Juliet Adams", "org_id": 1, "type": "user" } } ] } The results are paginated. Pass cursor from the response to get the next page. total counts all comments on the record, not only this page, and no replies. Requirements: records.comments:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key. Query parameters limitinteger Number of comments to return (default: 50). Min 1 Max 100 cursorstring Cursor of the next page. Reply to a comment​ Use this endpoint to reply to a comment or to another reply. POST/v1/reply/comment-or-reply/{comment_or_reply_id}api.tapeapp.com cURL JSON Request curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/reply/comment-or-reply/1000 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "value": "Thanks, I will check it today." }' Request { "value": "Thanks, I will check it today." } Response { "reply_id": 2000, "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "parent": { "type": "comment", "id": 1000 }, "created_on": "2022-03-01 14:00:00", "created_on_utc": "2022-03-01 13:00:00", "last_edit_on": null, "last_edit_on_utc": null, "files": [], "value": "Thanks, I will check it today.", "user": { "mail": ["will@acme.com"], "user_id": 601, "org_id": 1, "name": "Will Dawson", "type": "user" }, "created_by": { "mail": ["will@acme.com"], "user_id": 601, "org_id": 1, "name": "Will Dawson", "type": "user" } } To find a comment_id or reply_id, see Retrieve comments for a record and Retrieve replies for a record. Send the text of the reply in value. The example replies to the comment with ID 1000. ref points to the record. parent points to the activity the reply answers, here the comment with ID 1000. General behavior value supports the same formatting as a comment: line breaks with \n and user mentions. To attach files, send their temporary file IDs in file_ids. Replies have one level. A reply to a reply goes to the same parent as the reply you answer. created_by and user are null if Tape can't show the author, for example when an automation wrote the reply. Unlike a comment, a reply runs webhooks and automations only if you set hook and workflow to true. Requirements: records.comments:edit. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters silentboolean Don't send notifications for this change (default: false). hookboolean Run webhooks for this change (default: false). workflowboolean Trigger automations for this change (default: false). Body parameters valuestring Required. Text of the reply. file_idsArray Temporary file IDs of the files to attach. Retrieve replies for a record​ Use this endpoint to list all replies on a record, page by page. GET/v1/reply/record/{record_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/reply/record/1?limit=2 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "total": 3, "cursor": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJibGFiRGVmSWQiOjgsInZhbHVlcyI6WzE1OV0sImV4cCI6MTY1MDYxODc3OH0.iY5TnLSBDGCnFXbStcrLPTmP6MATnS_JKywbvC4tx3g", "replies": [ { "reply_id": 2000, "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "parent": { "type": "comment", "id": 1000 }, "created_on": "2022-03-01 14:00:00", "created_on_utc": "2022-03-01 13:00:00", "last_edit_on": null, "last_edit_on_utc": null, "files": [], "value": "Thanks, I will check it today.", "user": { "mail": ["will@acme.com"], "user_id": 601, "org_id": 1, "name": "Will Dawson", "type": "user" }, "created_by": { "mail": ["will@acme.com"], "user_id": 601, "org_id": 1, "name": "Will Dawson", "type": "user" } }, { "reply_id": 2001, "ref": { "type": "record", "id": 1 }, "parent": { "type": "comment", "id": 1000 }, "created_on": "2022-03-01 15:00:00", "created_on_utc": "2022-03-01 14:00:00", "last_edit_on": null, "last_edit_on_utc": null, "files": [], "value": "Great, thank you.", "user": { "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "user_id": 600, "org_id": 1, "name": "Juliet Adams", "type": "user" }, "created_by": { "mail": ["juliet@acme.com"], "user_id": 600, "org_id": 1, "name": "Juliet Adams", "type": "user" } } ] } The results are paginated. Pass cursor from the response to get the next page. General behavior The response contains every reply on the record. A reply can answer a comment, a field change or the creation of the record. parent.type tells you which: comment, revision, created, deleted, restored or invitation. Replies come grouped by the activity they answer, oldest activity first and oldest reply first. Replies with the same parent.id belong to the same thread. total is the number of all replies on the record. Only the first page contains it. Pages you get with a cursor return null. cursor is null on the last page. Use a cursor only with this endpoint and the same record. Any other cursor returns an error. Requirements: records.comments:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key. Query parameters limitinteger Number of replies to return (default: 50). Min 1 Max 100 cursorstring Cursor of the next page. Delete a comment or reply​ Use this endpoint to delete a comment or a reply by its ID. DELETE/v1/comment-or-reply/{comment_or_reply_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl -X DELETE https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/comment-or-reply/2000 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response {} General behavior Send the ID of a comment (comment_id) or of a reply (reply_id). You can delete only your own comments and replies. Requirements: records.comments:edit. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters silentboolean Don't send notifications for this change (default: false).

A record you can't view or comment on returns 400 with record_no_permission. Deleting a comment or reply that isn't your own returns 401. So does a request without a credential. A token without records.comments:read or records.comments:edit returns 403. A comment or reply that doesn't exist returns 404. See Errors for all error codes.

Record read the record a comment belongs to. File upload files to attach to comments and replies. Pagination read long lists of comments and replies page by page. Webhook get notified when someone comments on a record. Capabilities what records.comments:read and records.comments:edit allow.

documents.t: Record create, update and delete records. Record comment read and post comments on a record. Webhook get notified about record changes in your own backend instead. Capabilities what records:edit allows.
Use this endpoint to add, change and remove the permissions of users on up to 50 records in one request. PUT/v1/record/permission/batchNewapi.tapeapp.com

Each entry in add_permissions has a user_id or an email, and a permission_level. If no user in your organization has the email, Tape creates a new user and sends an invitation to join Tape. To find a user ID, see Retrieve organization users.

Each entry in update_permissions has a user_id or an email, and a permission_level. Tape changes the existing permission of that user. The email must belong to a user in your organization. Unlike add_permissions, update_permissions sends no invitation email. Use it to change a user's permission without notifying them.
Each entry in remove_permissions is a user ID or an email address. Tape removes the access you gave this user on the record. Access through a workspace membership or app permissions stays.

Send permission_level as a number: 5 Full access 4 Can share 3 Can edit 2 Can comment 1 Can view 0 No access A name such as CAN_SHARE or any other value returns 400 with validation. The message reads expected a valid permission level (3, 4 or 5), but all six numbers work.
Record create and update the records you share. User find the user_id of an organization user. Capabilities what records:share allows. Personal access tokens choose the content a token can reach.

Every record has a revision number, current_revision.revision in the record. It starts at 0 when the record is created and goes up by one with each change. Use this number as revision_id in the endpoints below. A revision contains its author as created_by, its date and time as created_on and its revision number. Retrieve revisions for a record​ Use this endpoint to list all revisions of a record. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/revisionapi.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/1/revision \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "total": 2, "revisions": [ { "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "name": "Dan Jacob", "type": "user" }, "created_on": "2022-03-16 14:25:00", "type": "creation", "revision": 0 }, { "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "name": "Dan Jacob", "type": "user" }, "created_on": "2022-03-16 14:30:00", "type": "update", "revision": 1 } ] } The example reads the revisions of record 1. User Dan Jacob (ID 600) created the record and updated it once. The response has no pagination and no cursor. Looking for the changed values? A revision holds only metadata, not the changed values. To see the changes, use Retrieve revision delta. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Query parameters include_deletedboolean Also return the revisions of a deleted record that is still in a trash you can access (default: false). Retrieve revision delta​ Use this endpoint to see which field values changed in one revision. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/revision/previous/{revision_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/1/revision/previous/1 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "record_id": 1, "from_revision_id": 0, "to_revision_id": 1, "revision_deltas": [ { "from": [], "external_id": "notes", "field_id": 2000, "label": "Notes", "to": [ { "value": "Some important notes" } ], "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "config": { "description": null, "required": false, "label": "Notes" } } ] } The example compares revision 1 of record 1 with the revision before it, revision 0. In the example, the single text field notes changed from no value to Some important notes. Key fields revision_deltas: one entry per changed field. One revision can change several fields when the same author changed them at the same time. from and to: the values before and after the change. They have the same format as the values of a record field. See Field values. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Revision lookback limit​ You can read deltas only for the last 50 revisions of a record. An older revision returns a 400 error (see Errors): Response { "status_code": 400, "endpoint": "/v1/record/1/revision/previous/123", "error_code": "validation", "error_message": "Revision ID 123 is too old. You can maximally go back 50 revisions" } Retrieve the last revision​ Use this endpoint to read a record as it was before its most recent change. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/revision/lastapi.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/1/revision/last \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" Response { "record_id": 1, "app_record_id": 1, "app_id": 1, "created_on": "2022-03-16 14:25:00", "created_on_utc": "2022-03-16 13:25:00", "last_modified_on": "2022-03-16 14:25:00", "last_modified_on_utc": "2022-03-16 13:25:00", "created_by": { "user_id": 600, "name": "Dan Jacob", "type": "user" }, "last_modified_by": { "user_id": 600, "name": "Dan Jacob", "type": "user" }, "fields": [ { "field_id": 2000, "external_id": "notes", "label": "Notes", "type": "text", "field_type": "single_text", "values": [] } ] } The response has the same fields format as a record. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Retrieve a record at a revision​ Use this endpoint to read a record as it was at a given revision. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/revision/at/{revision_id}api.tapeapp.com Request curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/record/1/revision/at/0 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" The response has the same format as Retrieve the last revision. General behavior revision_id 0 returns the record as it was created. The revision lookback limit applies here too. Requirements: records:read. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key. Errors A revision_id higher than the latest revision of the record returns 400.

Use this endpoint to see which field values changed in one revision. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/revision/previous/{revision_id}api.tapeapp.com

An older revision returns a 400 error (see Errors): Response { "status_code": 400, "endpoint": "/v1/record/1/revision/previous/123", "error_code": "validation", "error_message": "Revision ID 123 is too old. You can maximally go back 50 revisions" }
Use this endpoint to read a record as it was before its most recent change. GET/v1/record/{record_id}/revision/lastapi.tapeapp.com
